# Classic GUI Shop

A Fabric server shop mod with classic inventory menus, visual admin editing, exact item listings, folders, enchanted books, and economy commands.

## About

Classic GUI Shop adds a simple server shop system for Fabric servers or single player worlds.

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0995c978fc280da5e062f0019d3e109ca38ab300.png)

Players can browse shop menus, buy items, sell items, check item worth, sell items from their hand, and use enchanted book shops.

_Admins can manage listings through a visual editor using `/adminshop`, making setup easier without forcing every shop entry to be handled manually._

---

# Back From The Dead But Better

Classic GUIShop is a modern Fabric adaptation, complete rewrite and overhaul of the old classic plugin that was a chest-based shop experience for bukkit back in the day. I set out to make a simple port for my own little community server, but there was no way around a full rewrite to adapt it to modern Minecraft and the Fabric Loader, I wanted to share that with all you.

## Features

* Server-side only supported
* Single Player Supported
* Classic inventory based shop menus
* `/shop` player menu
* `/adminshop` visual admin editor
* Buy and sell listings
* All Vanilla Items auto listed/Priced
* Enchanted book buying
* Enchanted book selling
* Exploit alerts via recipie checks
* Datapack and Modded Item importing supported
* Item worth checks
* Sell hand commands
* Exact item identification
* Money System built-in
* Compatibility layer for quick porting to newly realeased versions

---
## Player Commands

### Common player commands include:

- `/shop` - Opens the shop GUI
- `/shop sell` Opens the Shop GUI in sell mode
- `/shop enchant` Opens the Shop GUI but stright to the enchantment listings
- `/sellhand` Sells the stack you are holding
- `/worth` Tells you the worth of the item you are holding
- `/ident` Allows you to know the id of the item you are holding

Admin tools are available through `/adminshop`. For more details on adminshop check out the wiki somewhere on this page.

---

# Why bring it back?

I havent seen something quite like this in a long time so, I brought it back with the help of AI. It is built for servers that want a simple, familiar, and highly configurable economy shop without annoying extra setup just to get started.

The main goal is simple: **drop it in, start the server, and have a working shop.**

Classic GUIShop generates a usable shop out of the box, includes its own persistent economy, supports permissions, and provides in-game tools for editing and managing shop content. You can Import items into it from Datapacks, and other mods. All the listings are completely configurable by the server admins. You can also run it on a single player world. Although you cannot edit the shop unless you have commands enabled.

If you are running this on a server, **you do not need to have this mod installed on the client.**

_Feel free to use this in any modpack, I also don't care if anyone wants to make edits to the code, you can fork it in the git. If you need help with it, hmu in discord, link should be somewhere on this page. This is my gift back to the modding community. I love you guys <3_

---

## Works out of the box

Classic GUIShop is designed to be usable immediately after installation.

On first run, the mod creates its configuration files, builds a starter shop, sets up default pricing, and prepares the economy system automatically. You do not need to manually write a full shop config before players can start using it.

This makes it useful for:

- Survival servers
- Small community servers
- SMPs
- Economy-based servers
- Admins who want a classic GUI shop without heavy setup

---

## Dynamic shop system

Classic GUIShop is not just a static list of items. It includes tools and systems that help the shop adapt to your server or singleplayer game.

Features include:

- Chest-style shop menus
- Buy and sell support
- Dynamic pricing support
- Automatic vanilla item catalog generation
- Version-safe item handling
- Enchanted book buying and selling
- Folder/category-based shop organization
- Configurable shop listings
- In-game admin editing tools

The mod is built to make shop management easier while still allowing server owners to customize prices, categories, and permissions.

---

## Built-in economy

Classic GUIShop includes its own economy system, so it can run independently without requiring another economy mod.

Players can earn, spend, and manage balances through the shop system. Server owners can use the built-in economy tools without needing to install a separate currency provider.

This keeps the setup lightweight and reliable.

---

## Permissions support

Classic GUIShop includes permission-aware command and admin access.

Server owners can control who has access to shop commands, economy commands, import tools, and admin editing features. If a permissions API is not installed, the mod falls back to standard Minecraft permission levels.

This means it can work on a simple server with no extra permission mods, while still supporting more controlled setups.

---

## Admin-friendly tools

Classic GUIShop is built with server management in mind.

Admins can manage shop content through commands and GUI-based tools instead of editing every listing manually. The mod supports importing, editing, pricing, and organizing items into shop categories.

Useful admin features include:

- In-game shop editor
- Shop reload support
- Item identification tools
- Configurable permission defaults
- Console import reminders
- Automatic handling of unavailable version-specific items

---

## Fabric API not required

Classic GUIShop does **not** require Fabric API.

The mod is built to run as a lightweight Fabric server-side shop mod using Fabric Loader directly. This helps reduce dependency issues and makes the mod easier to run across supported Minecraft versions.

If Fabric API is installed on your server, make sure your Fabric Loader version is compatible with that Fabric API release.

---

## Why Use Classic GUIShop?

Classic GUIShop is made for server owners who want the familiar chest GUI shop style, but with modern Fabric support and less setup hassle.

It focuses on being:

- Easy to install
- Usable immediately
- Server-friendly
- Highly configurable
- Permission-aware
- Dynamic enough for long-term server use

Whether you want a simple survival shop or a more organized server economy, Classic GUIShop gives you a strong starting point without forcing you to build everything from scratch.
